mapper.insert: INSERT INTO privileged_credential_attestation (credential_row_id, org_id, source, attested_at) SELECT #{credentialRowId}, om.org_id, 'FOUNDER', UTC_TIMESTAMP(3) FROM org_member om JOIN organization o ON o.id = om.org_id WHERE om.user_id = #{userId} AND om.founder = TRUE AND om.org_role = 'owner' AND o.lifecycle_state = 'active' ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE privileged_credential_attestation.source = privileged_credential_attestation.source

INSERT INTO privileged_credential_attestation (credential_row_id, org_id, source, attested_at) SELECT #{credentialRowId}, source_coverage.org_id, 'INHERITED', UTC_TIMESTAMP(3) FROM privileged_credential_attestation source_coverage JOIN organization o ON o.id = source_coverage.org_id WHERE source_coverage.credential_row_id = #{sourceCredentialRowId} AND o.lifecycle_state = 'active' ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE privileged_credential_attestation.source = privileged_credential_attestation.source

INSERT INTO privileged_credential_attestation (credential_row_id, org_id, source, attested_at) SELECT c.id, #{orgId}, 'FOUNDER', UTC_TIMESTAMP(3) FROM webauthn_credential c JOIN webauthn_user_entity e ON e.id = c.user_entity_user_id WHERE e.user_id = #{userId} ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE privileged_credential_attestation.source = privileged_credential_attestation.source

INSERT INTO privileged_credential_attestation (credential_row_id, org_id, source, grant_id, attested_at) VALUES (#{credentialRowId}, #{orgId}, 'GRANTOR', #{grantId}, UTC_TIMESTAMP(3)) AS incoming ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE grant_id = IF(privileged_credential_attestation.source = 'INHERITED', incoming.grant_id, privileged_credential_attestation.grant_id), attested_at = IF(privileged_credential_attestation.source = 'INHERITED', incoming.attested_at, privileged_credential_attestation.attested_at), source = IF(privileged_credential_attestation.source = 'INHERITED', incoming.source, privileged_credential_attestation.source)
